name: Events Route - Past Results From The October All-Hands
description: The /events past grid now that the NYC Fall Welcome Mixer is written up after the fact: its card leads with "Sold out within 24 hours, with more than 90% of registrants attending", the October 2026 volunteer all-hands figure, instead of the old space-is-limited pitch. The card clamps its description, which is why the result comes first. Alumni Day (June 5) sits at the bottom of the frame; its 120-alumni write-up is in the card below the fold. The hover only scrolls the past grid into view.
